'''Faust''' were a tall, slender [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adana/Legends|Adana]] within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. They had a vaguely [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] figure, being bipedal with a single pair of upper manipulative appendages. They had a double set of eyelids, light-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and pale blue-gray skin. They had long, humanoid faces with slanted, almond-shaped eyes, a long nose, large [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and a cranial ridge. It is unknown whether [[Gender/Legends|females]] of the species share this trait or if it is exclusively a distinguishing attribute of the males. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] was a member of this race.

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], the author of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'', stated on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] in [[August]] [[2009]] that this species was called the Faust.<ref name="Jason Fry name">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=jasonfry|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802104427/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109}}</ref> However, this information was from a pre-published version of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']]. This reference was removed from the final version of the book, and according to Fry, Vindi's species was unclear at that time.<ref name="Jason Fry not name">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30392547|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=jasonfry|date=2009-08-31|time=12:24 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802104038/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-111}}</ref> The [[June]] [[2010]] publication of Fry's ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', stating that Vindi was a Faust, made the name official.
